caption: The drawing depicts a single object that is a flying, winged figure resembling a cherub or angel, colored primarily in shades of turquoise, green, and bronze with patina-like texture. The figure has childlike facial features and a head of stylized, wavy hair. The angel is shown in a horizontal, flying position facing to the left, with its legs bent backward and arms extended forward. It is holding a large, conical trumpet to its mouth with both hands, and the trumpet appears metallic with a green-blue hue, matching much of the patina coloring seen on the figure's body and limbs. The figure also has detailed feathered wings that are colored brown and bronze, and they are spread outward. There are no other objects or background details in the image, aside from minimal handwritten text in the bottom right corner. The drawing is set against a plain, light-colored background.
